about_the_game:
What is "MusicRunner"?

A new type of rhythm action game which you run through music 🎵

Welcome to MusicRunner, a new rhythm and action music game! Run through the world, avoiding obstacles by jumping and moving, while defeating slimes in rhythm. Try to get back the “pieces of sound” stolen by the slimes!

More than 40 songs and many attractive characters are available! More songs will be continuously added through updates! The game includes a large number of songs and scores, from those for music game beginners to those that are like a challenge to the super advanced players. Run through the world with your favorite songs and characters to achieve a high score!

Exhilarating player action!

Attack enemies! Attack at the right time to increase your score!

Jump to avoid rocks on the ground!

Move left and right to collect coins and avoid trees!

Difficulty Levels for Everyone to Enjoy!

Each song has three types of scores: EASY, HARD, and CRAZY, which can be enjoyed by everyone from music game beginners to advanced players! The difficulty level EASY can be played with only 5 keys!

"RUN" is a fun way to ride the rhythm of the music!

Aim for a high score by riding the rhythm of the music! At the height of the music, you will be in a “fever” state. Let's boost up the tension!

Three modes to expand the range of your play!

Free Mode

Choose your favorite songs to play! Play the same song over and over again for a high score, or create your own running course..!

Adventure Mode

Try to get back “pieces of sound” by conquering the stages! Receive rewards such as songs and characters by completing the missions set in each stage!

Course

Test your skills! Play the designated songs in succession.

Information for super music game player

★Score Calculation Method

Score is determined solely by your ability to play the sound game.

Score is calculated by “Internal Score/Internal Score Theoretical Value*1000000+Internal CRITICAL Number”. There is no combo addition, so the score is determined by a simple percentage.

Internal Score

COINS: 4 points

CRITICAL: 4 points

ATTACK: 3 points

MISS: 0 points

Internal Score Theoretical Value

Total number of coins*4Total number of notes*4

For example, the theoretical value of a score with 100 total notes and 200 total coins is 1000100.

We may implement character types and character levels that affect the difficulty of clearing songs, but not those that affect the score.

★Judgment width

Internal CRITICAL judgment: 25 ms

CRITICAL judgment: 40ms

ATTACK judgment: 120ms
